identification: Evelyn Antonysen (north-west Tasmania), whimsical cats with resist lines, signed lower right, framed with green mat and gilt slip. Probably an original watercolour (she paints in watercolour), but not confirmed from photo. Cat subjects are unusual for her; her output is mainly landscapes, birds and flowers.
